Monopulse raises more than €2 million for production and R&D

The investment supports manufacturing and market expansion alongside work on resilience to disrupted communications and navigation.

Tech.eu ↗12 October 2026English editorial summary
StoryImages 1

Capital for manufacturing growth

MNP Technologijos, trading as Monopulse, raised more than €2 million from Lithuanian and international investors. Participants include Coinvest Capital, Plug and Play, LitBAN and an NGL Ventures syndicate contributing €560,000 from 68 investors.

Hardware and software development

The Danish-Lithuanian company develops Falcon MK3S and HydroHex systems, combining electronics, sensor fusion, computer vision and AI. Maintaining communication or autonomous operation when signals are disrupted is a development focus, not a guarantee against every interference condition.

Watch production and delivery

Tech.eu reports existing use by Lithuanian and Danish armed forces. The investment supports manufacturing, R&D and expansion in Scandinavia and other international markets, without specifying added unit capacity or independently comparable resilience results.
